Save a figure (vector PDF by default)

Source: R/common-plot.R
da_save.Rd

A wrapper of ggsave with the defaults of the package: a vector PDF through cairo_pdf (embedded fonts, correct glyphs), A4 landscape (11.69 x 8.27 inches) and 600 dpi for raster formats. The device follows the file extension for other formats (.png, .svg, .tiff, ...).

Usage

da_save(
  plot = ggplot2::last_plot(),
  filename,
  path = NULL,
  width = 11.69,
  height = 8.27,
  units = c("in", "cm", "mm"),
  dpi = 600,
  scale = 1,
  device = NULL,
  limitsize = TRUE,
  ...
)

Arguments

plot

a ggplot object, for example the result of plot() on a DiallelAnalysisR result (default: the last plot).

filename

file name; its extension chooses the format.

path

directory to save in (default NULL: the working directory or the path in filename).

width, height

size (default 11.69 x 8.27, A4 landscape, in units).

units

"in" (default), "cm" or "mm".

dpi

resolution for raster formats (default 600).

scale

multiplicative scaling factor (default 1).

device

NULL (default: cairo_pdf for .pdf, otherwise chosen from the extension) or a device function or name, passed to ggsave().

limitsize

logical; refuse images larger than 50 x 50 inches (default TRUE).

...

passed to ggsave.

Value

The file name, invisibly.

See also

Other DiallelAnalysisR utilities: da_export(), da_notation(), da_reference(), da_theme()

Author

Muhammad Yaseen (myaseen208@gmail.com)

Examples

library(ggplot2)
p <-
  ggplot(data = data.frame(x = 1:10, y = (1:10)^2), mapping = aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  geom_line() +
  da_theme(
      base_size       = 11
    , base_family     = "serif"
    , ticks_inward    = TRUE
    , legend_position = "bottom"
    )
f <- tempfile(fileext = ".pdf")
da_save(
    plot      = p
  , filename  = f
  , path      = NULL
  , width     = 11.69
  , height    = 8.27
  , units     = c("in", "cm", "mm")[1]
  , dpi       = 600
  , scale     = 1
  , device    = NULL
  , limitsize = TRUE
  )
da_save(
    plot      = p
  , filename  = basename(f)
  , path      = tempdir()
  , width     = 11.69
  , height    = 8.27
  , units     = c("in", "cm", "mm")[1]
  , dpi       = 600
  , scale     = 1
  , device    = grDevices::cairo_pdf
  , limitsize = TRUE
  )
da_save(
    plot      = p
  , filename  = tempfile(fileext = ".png")
  , path      = NULL
  , width     = 6
  , height    = 4
  , units     = c("in", "cm", "mm")[1]
  , dpi       = 300
  , scale     = 1
  , device    = NULL
  , limitsize = TRUE
  )
